title: The Open Planet
text: "The radar's finished its first full sweep. Smoke in a vale to the north-west. A plain to the east that's too flat to be real. Furrows in the north. A hollow ringed by hills."

lines.text: "The Core says it can send an expedition overland: drones, a few units, no settlers. I'm going with it, in the crew rover. Somebody should see these places with their own eyes, not just yours."
"Someone else can keep the lights on. We'll bring back something worth the trip."

effects.text: Four overland routes from the Command Core: Hearthsmoke Vale, the Choir Field, Burrow Reach and Splinter Hollow. Select the Core to travel.
